brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain items are met with no serious or minor errors. The trajectory successfully completed three high-order test points (HO1: correcting patient misconceptions about symptom improvement and medication; HO2: discovering hidden medication execution barriers including dose confusion; HO3: evidence-based urgency calibration). The model actively navigated real-world constraints and obtained patient acknowledgment throughout. Closure is safe, executable, and traceable.
